description: Fires mainly when the opponent's last stone landed in row 4 (the fifth stone, second from the top) of column 2, the third column from the left. This holds for most column contents, but weaker if column 2 is all one colour. The rest of the firing is spread over other last-move cells that only sometimes fire, such as row 1 of column 6, row 3 of columns 1/5, row 0 of column 4, and early pure stacks like 4,4,4,4.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most 0.01.
notes: Layer-1 last-move-cell unit. Best dev F1 0.466 (P 0.54, R 0.41), sim share 0.30. (4,2) landings fire in act tests across fillers, higher at even ply. Adding the secondary cells to fires dropped F1 to 0.25 (they are common and fire only in some contexts), and no simple context rule worked in minimal pairs. Synthesis peaked at 1.622 (4,4,4,4), which is below the dev max of 1.670.
